scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-gia-pha --only firestore,storage "vitest run tests/rules.test.ts"
scripts.test:backend: npm run build:backend && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-gia-pha --only auth,firestore,functions "vitest run functions/tests/backend.test.ts --testTimeout=30000"
scripts.test:proposals: npm run build:backend && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-gia-pha --only auth,firestore,functions "vitest run functions/tests/proposals.test.ts --testTimeout=30000"
scripts.emulators: npm run build:backend && firebase emulators:start --project demo-gia-pha
